rows.live_alt: Airborne radar view revealing structural elements of Camp Century beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: NASA 2024 airplane-wing aerial PHOTO ABOVE radar strip/inset composite; existing ALT omits photo and inset.
rows.source_authority: NASA Earth Observatory; Michala Garrison/Jesse Allen, JPL and Goddard data
rows.rights_review: NASA media guidelines allow general informational use subject to attribution, NASA nonendorsement and third-party exceptions. Asset-specific clearance not completed.
rows.identity_review: Similar full composite; exact PopSci binary identity unverified.
rows.proposed_alt: NASA 2024 photo of airplane wing over Greenland above a colored radar image and inset revealing buried Camp Century.

rows.live_alt: U.S. Army engineers constructing a steel-roofed trench at Camp Century on the Greenland Ice Sheet.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Archival photograph looking down snow trench, arched steel covering, people and vehicle; original photographer unknown.
rows.source_authority: US Army Corps of Engineers CRREL technical report 174, figure 14
rows.rights_review: Candidate Commons public-domain-US-government claim; source photograph on newspaper CDN has unverified rights.
rows.identity_review: Illustrative Army alternative, NOT exact image.
rows.proposed_alt: People and equipment working in a deep snow trench under curved corrugated steel roofing at Camp Century.

rows.live_alt: Camp Century trench deformation showing steel arches distorted inward by the surrounding firn and ice.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Two comparative tunnel deformation cross-section diagrams dated Dec 1960, Feb 1961 and Aug 1963, with numeric scale; NOT a picture of steel arches.
rows.source_authority: US Army Materiel Command CRREL technical report 174, figures 28–29 p39
rows.rights_review: Commons labels Army report public domain, but confirm this specific scan/version; preserve small lettering.
rows.identity_review: Exact titled Commons image and publication figure identified; binary equality unverified.
rows.proposed_alt: Two scaled U.S. Army engineering trench cross-sections compare 1960–61 outlines with August 1963 inward deformation.

rows.live_alt: U.S. Army layout plan of Camp Century showing its underground corridors and facilities.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Detailed black-and-white historical Camp Century trench layout plan showing reactor, hot waste disposal, utilities and living quarters.
rows.source_authority: US Army CRREL technical report 174, figure 26 p34
rows.rights_review: Uncolorized Commons plan catalog says public domain US federal work; distinct colorized Commons plan is CC BY-SA 4.0 and NOT interchangeable.
rows.identity_review: Strong scene-level match, but publisher crop/version/binary unverified.
rows.proposed_alt: Camp Century historic plan labeling underground corridors, quarters, labs, reactor and disposal tunnels.

rows.live_alt: Camp Century scientists handling deep ice core material recovered from the Greenland Ice Sheet.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Two workers handling long drilling/core apparatus inside a historic Camp Century interior.
rows.source_authority: Camp Century science archive, historical David Atwood / AIP Emilio Segrè archive photographs
rows.rights_review: Archive expressly allows press coverage with attribution, NOT commercial reuse without permission; SciTechDaily original author/rights unknown.
rows.identity_review: Archive has related photographs only; exact SciTechDaily image match unverified.
rows.proposed_alt: Two workers handle drilling/core apparatus inside Camp Century; exact identities and date unresolved.

rows.live_alt: Camp Century map georeferenced to the 2017 radar-detected position beneath the moving Greenland Ice Sheet.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Research figure JPEG unavailable to independent image retriever; publisher caption independently confirms 2017 georeferenced as-built map and ±20m accuracy.
rows.source_authority: Karlsson, Colgan et al., Cold Regions Science and Technology 165 (2019), Fig. 23; GEUS
rows.rights_review: Publisher says open access under Creative Commons; exact variant, figure credits and derivative rights unverified. ResearchGate warns content may be copyrighted.
rows.identity_review: Figure subject/caption match; binary identity and license unverified.
rows.proposed_alt: Georeferenced Camp Century as-built layout based on 2017 radar, with estimated horizontal accuracy of plus or minus 20 meters.
